blocks.title: Read Me First
rows: Receptionist Daily Log
Filled by the Receptionist at end of each day. Visible to the Front Desk Manager.
How this works
One row per day. Receptionist fills at the end of each working day.
Tracks: footfall, calls, bookings, billing, complaints, sentiment.
Sentiment column: Green (clean), Amber (some friction), Red (significant issue).
Second sheet — Monthly Front Desk Plan. Reviewed monthly with the FDM.

blocks.title: Monthly Front Desk Plan
rows: Monthly Front Desk Plan
Reviewed monthly with the Front Desk Manager. Forward-looking on experience, accuracy and discipline.
Month / Branch:
1. LAST MONTH (scorecard average, feedback, callback completion — what worked, what didn't)
2. THIS MONTH COMMITMENT (specific experience & accuracy targets)
3. TOP 3 ISSUES TO FIX (with the support needed)
4. CLIENT-EXPERIENCE IMPROVEMENTS (specific actions to lift feedback)
5. SKILL DEVELOPMENT (calls, billing, CRM — what to get sharper on)
6. ASKS OF THE FDM (anything needed to hold the standard)
